findings.text: follow-on: NAMED_WINDOW_MINUTES duplicates the length-to-named-window map this module already owns at reckon/budget.py:4081 (WINDOW_MINUTES_CLOCK = {300: CLOCK_FIVE_HOUR, 10080: CLOCK_SEVEN_DAY}, with CLOCK_FIVE_HOUR/CLOCK_SEVEN_DAY declared at budget.py:2388-2390 and _clock_for_window at budget.py:4131 placing a length on a named clock). The two tables carry identical pairs in the same file, so a later window length must be added to both or the recorded series and the published document resolve the same length to two different names; _previously the module had one such map, and the change adds a second rather than extending the first.

follow-on: the real-home guard now searches only for the run ids this file mints, so it can only ever report a write the fixture itself made. The needle it replaced (the project name, which every live pointer carries) is what would have caught a production path writing a live pointer under the real crew/live, and nothing else in the run directory checks that direction. It also passes vacuously for a case that calls no _record, because tests/real_home_traces.py:57 discards empty needles, so a file that stopped minting ids would keep a green guard. The narrowing is the right repair for the false positive it names -- the same needles also matched every peer pointer and failed at teardown on a peer's dispatch -- but the guard it leaves is weaker than the one it replaces, and no case demonstrations the new one's refusal the way the negative controls demonstrate the window filter's.

follow-on: the guard paragraph asserts "Sampled three consecutive runs after the change: eleven passed each time", but the run directory holds one head-arm run and no log of the three-run sampling, so the sampling is claimed rather than receipted. This is the same shape as the ruff claim the previous review sent back, which this round answered by adding ruff-delta.log; the manifest's test_logs names no file for the three-run sample either.

follow-on: _window_key declares fallback_minutes but no caller supplies it -- budget.py:943 is its only call site and passes the block alone -- so the parameter is dead and the fallback path it implies is neither exercised by a case nor reachable in production.
